notes: 4 photos, all legible printed menus. Photos 1 and 3 are close-ups of a laminated wall menu (Breakfast page; Sandwiches/Hamburgers/Omelettes page). Photo 4 shows a bound table menu with the same two pages but noticeably higher prices for identical items (e.g. Short Stack 4.99 vs 6.99) — likely a later price update, so photo 4's prices were used wherever items overlap. Photo 2 (George's Specials, Kid's Menu, Beverages, Desserts, Side Orders) has no duplicate photo, so its prices were used as printed.
